name: @projexlight/sdk-evidence
summary: Chain-of-custody evidence ledger for ProjexCloud: capture (photos / videos / documents / signatures) → variant generation (thumbnail / OCR / redacted) → tamper-evident hash + signature → legal export bundle. Every transition writes to sdk-audit; variants stay linked to the original capture so adjudication can replay the full forensic trail. Foundation SDK for field-service, insurance claims, and healthcare verticals.

endpoints.description: Register a new evidence capture (binary uploaded out-of-band via sdk-media presigned URL). Returns evidence_id.
Fetch a single evidence record + its chain-of-custody trail.
List captures for a tenant + optional persona / encounter / date filters.

events.name: evidence.capture.registered.v1
events.description: New capture committed; carries SHA-256 of the source bytes.

events.name: evidence.variant.derived.v1
events.description: Variant (thumbnail / OCR / redacted) produced from a capture.

events.name: evidence.custody.transferred.v1
events.description: Custody handoff (e.g. tech → adjuster); each handoff appended to the chain.

events.name: evidence.export.requested.v1
events.description: Legal export bundle requested (for discovery, regulatory submission).

events.name: evidence.export.signed.v1
events.description: Export bundle finalized + signed; signing chain attested by the regional chain-head key.

models.description: Root capture row: source bytes hash, mime, geo-stamp, captured-by persona, encounter ref.
Derived form (thumbnail / OCR text / redacted variant); always linked to a capture.
Append-only handoff log per capture: from_persona, to_persona, reason, witnessed_at.
Export-request rows: requested_by, scope, status, signing_chain_id, expires_at (7-day TTL by default).

hooks.name: registerCapture
hooks.description: Service entry — accepts a presigned media ref + metadata; emits evidence.capture.registered.v1 + writes the first chain entry.

hooks.name: deriveVariant
hooks.description: Run a derivation (thumbnail / OCR / PII-redaction); stores the variant + links to the source capture.

hooks.name: transferCustody
hooks.description: Append a custody handoff. Refuses on missing witnessed_by when the tenant policy demands it.

hooks.name: exportLegalBundle
hooks.description: Assemble + sign a discovery bundle for a capture set; bundle TTL is 7 days by default.

scenarios.title: Field tech captures a proof-of-work photo with attestation
scenarios.when_to_use: Mobile app uploads a photo via sdk-media presigned URL; sdk-evidence registers the capture so it's discoverable in the adjudication trail.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns evidence_id. Emits evidence.capture.registered.v1 to the audit chain. The first chain_of_custody row is written with the capturing persona as the holder.

scenarios.title: Auto-redact bystander faces into a variant
scenarios.when_to_use: Photo carries identifiable bystanders; before sharing with the customer we need a PII-redacted variant that's safe to release.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns variant_id pointing at the redacted blob. Original capture untouched. Emits evidence.variant.derived.v1 carrying the derivation provenance for replay.

scenarios.title: Insurance claim: field adjuster hands off custody to senior reviewer
scenarios.when_to_use: Claim escalates from triage to senior review; the chain-of-custody trail records every handoff so disputes can replay the path the evidence took.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Appends to evidence.chain_of_custody. Emits evidence.custody.transferred.v1. Refuses with a structured error if witnessed_by is missing and the tenant policy requires it.

scenarios.title: Discovery / regulatory submission — sign a legal export bundle
scenarios.when_to_use: Customer's legal team needs a signed bundle for a court date, regulator request, or DSAR fulfillment.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Bundle assembled in S3 with a signed manifest; signing chain attested by the regional chain-head key. Emits .export.requested + .export.signed. Recipients have 7 days to download.

scenarios.title: Tenant offboards → evidence corpus shredded on grace expiry
scenarios.when_to_use: Reactive: sdk-tenant-lifecycle fires tenant.offboarded.v1; sdk-evidence's worker scrubs the corpus along with the rest of the SDK fan-out.
scenarios.expected_outcome: All capture rows + variant rows + S3 objects gone. Audit chain retains the .shredded event so the customer can prove erasure to their regulator.

compliance_posture.notes: Federal Rules of Evidence 902/1001 self-authentication satisfied by SHA-256 source-hash + signed chain-of-custody. 21 CFR Part 11 met for life-sciences evidence via the signing chain + chain_head attestation. HIPAA right-of-access (164.524) supported by the legal-export flow scoped per subject.

pricing_skus.unit_description: per capture registered (binary storage billed separately via sdk-media)
per variant generated (PII-redact + OCR are compute-heavy)
